about.title: About Me
about.body: Full-Stack Web Developer based in Belgium, building production-ready applications with Next.js, React, Node.js and MongoDB. Experienced across responsive UI development, backend services, REST APIs, database design, third-party integrations and deployment. I've delivered projects for real estate, travel, e-commerce, photography, technology and finance, including multilingual platforms for international users.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of my recent work

one.title: Los Estate — Real Estate Platform
one.description: Full-stack property platform with reusable components, backend services and MongoDB persistence. Property listing, sales/rental experiences, API-driven data flows and multilingual functionality.

two.title: Vibra Travel — Travel Platform
two.description: Commercial travel platform with destination, trip, testimonial and promotional experiences, Node.js backend and MongoDB-backed data flows, plus booking-related integrations.

three.title: Latore Atelier — Fashion E-Commerce
three.description: Product catalogue and shopping interfaces with a full-stack Next.js/Node.js architecture, MongoDB product data and multilingual responsive experiences.

four.title: Pic Best Moments — Photography Platform
four.description: Commercial photography platform with responsive galleries, image-focused interfaces, backend services and multilingual customer-facing pages.

six.title: GRW Wine
six.description: Commercial full-stack web platform combining a responsive frontend, backend services and database functionality.

seven.title: Mejor Tech
seven.description: Multilingual technology platform supporting English, Arabic, Russian and Spanish, built with a non-MongoDB database system.
